title: Simbi database: historical hydro-meteorological time series and catchment attributes in Haiti, 1905-2005
description: Haiti is highly exposed to hydro-climatic hazards. However, no database exists for the scientific community to characterize these hazards. To fill this gap, hydro-climatic data were compiled to create the first historical database in Haiti. This database, called Simbi, will contribute to a better knowledge of Haitian catchment hydrology.
authors: Bathelemy, Ralph; Brigode, Pierre; Andréassian, Vazken; Perrin, Charles; Moron, Vincent; Gaucherel, Cédric; Tric, Emmanuel; Boisson, Dominique
